rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Vino Delicado
Exhibition name: Vino Delicado
rows.Origin:
Bred by Frank C. Raffel (United States, before 1972).
Introduced in United States by Port Stockton Nursery in 1972 as 'Vino Delicado'.
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1975 as 'Vino Delicado'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve, purple edges. Mild fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
